# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God the Just Giver — Song of Trust

---

**5:1** O LORD God — I will praise your name with joy,
among all who know your righteous judgments!

**5:2** For you are good and merciful, the hope of the poor;
who in all the world is like you, O God?

**5:3** I will praise your name among those who love you;
for you are good and lavish in mercy toward Israel.

**5:4** Blessed are those born in those days
to see the good that God will do for Israel when he gathers the tribes home!

**5:5** May God purify Israel for the day of his mercy and blessing,
for the day of his choosing when he brings back his anointed.

**5:6** Blessed are those who live to see those days
and behold the good things the LORD will do for the coming generation —

**5:7** under the discipline of the LORD's anointed,
who walks in the fear of his God, in the spirit of wisdom and righteousness and strength:

**5:8** who will guide every person in works of righteousness through the fear of God,
establishing them all before the LORD as a good and faithful generation.

**5:9** Blessed are those born in those days
to see the good things of the LORD for the generation yet to come.

**5:10** May the mercy of the LORD rest on Israel forever and ever!

**5:11** For you, O God, are our king forever and ever;
in you, O God, our souls take their pride.

**5:12** How short a man's days on earth —
all his hope is proportioned to the brief span of his life.

**5:13** But we — we hope in God our savior;
for the power of our God endures forever in mercy,
and the kingdom of our God rules over all nations in righteous judgment forever.

**5:14** You, O LORD, chose Abraham above all the nations;
you sealed your covenant with him and with his seed forever.

**5:15** You never abandoned us;
you gathered our scattered people of Israel from among the strangers.

**5:16** Great and holy is the LORD our God;
the strength of our God rests in Jerusalem forever.

**5:17** And the mercy of the LORD is over the houses of Israel
forever and ever.

**5:18** For the LORD shelters his faithful ones;
he wipes away their failures through his loving discipline.

**5:19** For the life of the righteous goes on forever —
but sinners will be dragged away to destruction and remembered no more.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
